content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline
content.Section: 7.1. Revascularization to Improve Survival in SIHD Compared With Medical Therapy
content.Summary: This guideline discusses various clinical trials and studies comparing the effectiveness of coronary artery bypass surgery (CABG) and percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in improving survival for patients with stable ischemic heart disease, left ventricular dysfunction, and other coronary conditions. It includes meta-analyses and randomized controlled trial outcomes demonstrating the benefits or comparing different strategies for coronary revascularization.
